cohort: 121 pregnant women with COVID-19 treated at two hospitals in Pakistan, mean age 27 years (SD 5, range 19-40), 48.3% primigravida, 51.3% in their 3rd trimester, and 34.7% between 35-40 weeks gestation.
finding: COVID-19 may be associated with negative fetal outcomes such as preterm birth, fetal pain, respiratory symptoms, and low birth weight.
birth_weight: LBW mentioned as a possible outcome, but no specific data provided
